VI.description: Opens a new instance of RemoteVI Server Loop.vi\2C found next to this VI (both live in source\5CServer)\3A the Server Loop is reentrant (preallocated clone)\2C and Open VI Reference with option 0x08 (prepare for reentrant run) returns a reference to a clone of its own\2C so every share of this LabVIEW application instance runs its own loop. loop VI (not empty) opens that VI instead the same way - RemoteVI Start Landing Page.vi opens the reentrant RemoteVI Landing Server.vi. Nothing is opened on an incoming error.

Control.description: Another reentrant loop VI with the Server Loop's controls\3B empty (default)\3A RemoteVI Server Loop.vi.
